title:
This MRT stayed
*closed for 8 years*

lines.say: You are a buyer in 2010. There's a brand new MRT station near Bidadari. But it's closed, and has been since 2003.
lines.cap: you are a buyer in 2010. a brand new MRT near Bidadari. *closed since 2003*

lines.say: Why? Too few people lived there. The land was an old cemetery, closed in 1972 and cleared by 2006.
lines.cap: too few people lived there. *an old cemetery*, closed 1972, cleared by 2006

lines.say: In 2011, the MRT finally opened. Two years later, the government unveiled the Bidadari estate plan.
lines.cap: 2011: *the MRT finally opened*. 2013: the Bidadari estate plan

lines.say: In 2018, Park Colonial launched beside the MRT at around seventeen hundred dollars psf.
lines.cap: 2018: Park Colonial launched beside the MRT at *around $1,700 psf*

lines.say: In 2019, The Woodleigh Residences launched above a new mall and bus interchange, from seventeen thirty three psf.
Today, Park Colonial averages about twenty three fifty psf. Woodleigh Residences is around twenty four sixty.
lines.cap: today: Park Colonial *about $2,350 psf*. Woodleigh Residences *around $2,460*

lines.say: What changed? Not the land. An MRT came first, then a government plan, then a mall, a park and a bus interchange.
lines.cap: what changed? not the land. *an MRT, a plan, a mall and a park*

lines.say: So when you look at an area, don't ask if it's nice today. Ask what's coming next.
lines.cap: don't ask if an area is nice today. *ask what's coming next*

lines.say: Which area do you think is next? Comment below.

source: LTA / Wikipedia · HDB · NParks · EdgeProp · Stacked (12 mth avg)
caption:
Woodleigh MRT was built in 2003 and stayed closed until 2011. 🚇

The land around it was an old cemetery. Today, condos beside it average around $2,350 to $2,460 psf. What changed it: an MRT, a plan, a mall and a park.
